kinetic_limits: All four Figure8 panels show both acids; model1 inA/C and model2 inB/D. Table5 labelsA/C HCl andB/D HAc.
Prose x(%) notation requires fraction-versus-percent convention to be specified for transforms; plotted transformed ranges are compatible with fractional x, not an official unit correction.
Fit intercepts, weights, replicate transformed values, raw time points and sample bases unavailable. High R2 in two model forms does not uniquely establish both controlling mechanisms.
Graph error bars are visible; triplicates/means stated. Error-bar definition and raw replicates not given.

zeta.experiment: 200mL domestic sewage;0,50,100,150,200,250,300mg/L PAFAC; measured25C,equilibration30s,foldedcapillary cuvette; triplicate mean stated.
zeta.signed_direction: From0 to250mg/L mean becomes less negative (signed zeta increases, absolute magnitude decreases);300mg/L is more negative than250mg/L. No zero crossing is shown.
zeta.interpretation: Prose decreases/increases cannot be accepted as signed direction without clarification; could refer to magnitude but that is an inference. No exact values/error bars digitized or unique mechanism established.

mass_balance.source_equation1: eta_loss=100*(m0-mresidue)/m0; residue is filtered, repeatedly water-washed,dried and weighed.
mass_balance.parallel_arms: Independent fresh CGCS portions; no arithmetic addition or sequential recovery multiplication.
mass_balance.element_inventory_needed: For each arm: feed_E + reagent_E = residue_E + filtrate_E + wash_E + other_outputs_E + unaccounted_E. Quantify aliquots, entrainment and transfers without double counting.
mass_balance.ash_conversion: If a=m_ash/m_dryfeed and oxide entry o_E is a valid ash mass fraction, then element mass in dry feed would be m_dryfeed*a*o_E*(n_E*M_E/M_oxide). Neither a nor matched residual elemental assays are reported; this conditional identity is not a numerical recovery calculation.
mass_balance.product_inventory: Need actual liquor quantities entering3:2volume blend, elemental concentrations,NaOH and other reagent contributions, isolated product mass, moisture and validated elemental mass fractions. XRF percentages on different bases alone do not establish product yield.
mass_balance.qualifier: Table3 lacks explicit C/O entries despite hydroxide/acetate interpretation and totals100 withOthers; do not assume complete bulk mass closure or exact NaCl phase fraction from Na+Cl sum.
